model.name: infisical-operator
model.description: The Infisical Kubernetes Operator syncs secrets from Infisical into Kubernetes (InfisicalSecret), pushes Kubernetes secrets to Infisical (InfisicalPushSecret), and manages dynamic secret leases (InfisicalDynamicSecret). Deploy the operator with the Infisical secrets-operator Helm chart (https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/infisical/helm-charts/helm/charts/, chart secrets-operator).
